bundle.shortDescription: Light shows for LED strips and matrices, driven by music or played live
bundle.longDescription: darkRGB makes LED strips and matrices follow the music your computer is playing, lets you play them live from a keyboard, a touch screen or a MIDI controller, and runs unattended shows. It sends to WLED devices and to sACN and Art-Net pixel controllers.
